# Vendored GStreamer 1.0 runtime (arm64, Debian 13 "trixie")

**Status: scripted and reproducible.** Generated by
`tools/vendor-gstreamer-closure.sh` against
`golden-reference/snapshots/2026-09-07/package-manifest.txt` — see
`MANIFEST-FILES.md` for the exact per-file sha256 + source package.

## Why these are vendored instead of `apt install`ed

`apt install gstreamer1.0-plugins-good gstreamer1.0-plugins-bad` pulls 350+
packages and 750MB+ of X11/Wayland/dbus/PulseAudio/ONNX-runtime/OpenEXR
dependencies unrelated to this project's headless kmssink + v4l2 + alsa
pipeline, on a device with a 2GB SD card. Instead, this directory is the
*minimal delta*: exactly the plugin `.so` files this project's pipeline
string needs (`tools/gstreamer-plugin-allowlist.txt`), plus their
transitive shared-library dependencies that aren't already covered by
whatever's on the target Pi via its normal installed packages
(`avahi-daemon`, `ffmpeg`, `gdb`, base DietPi).

## Two install locations — don't flatten them together

- `plugins/` — GStreamer plugin modules, loaded specifically from
  `.../gstreamer-1.0/` (GStreamer's own plugin-scanner path), *including*
  `gst-plugin-scanner` itself (which actually lives one level up, at
  `.../gstreamer1.0/gstreamer-1.0/gst-plugin-scanner` — see
  `MANIFEST-FILES.md`'s recorded "orig path" for each file's real
  destination, since a couple of paths don't follow the naming you'd guess).
- `libs/` — general shared libraries those plugins link against
  (`libgstreamer-1.0.so.0`, `libv4l2.so.0`, etc.), which live directly
  under `.../aarch64-linux-gnu/`, *not* the plugin directory.

**This split matters because a prior manual extraction only ever captured
`plugins/`, silently missing every file that's now in `libs/`.** Those
files happened to already be present on the live Pi from an earlier,
undocumented step, which is exactly how the gap stayed invisible: the
device worked, but `provisioning/setup.sh` alone would *not* have
reproduced a working device, since it only ever installed to the plugin
directory. Fixed now — see `tools/vendor-gstreamer-closure.sh`'s "libs vs
plugins" classification and `customize-root.sh`'s install step.

## Filenames are at the soname level, not further-versioned

Files are named e.g. `libgstreamer-1.0.so.0`, not
`libgstreamer-1.0.so.0.2602.0` — that's what the dynamic linker actually
looks up (verified: `dpkg -S` and `ldd` both resolve at the soname-symlink
level, not the fully-versioned real filename), so no extra symlink needs
to be recreated at install time; the vendored file, named with the
soname, already is what `ld.so` is looking for.

## Regenerating this directory

```
tools/vendor-gstreamer-closure.sh <target-package-manifest> vendor/gstreamer-1.0-arm64-trixie
```
using a fresh `golden-reference/` capture as the target manifest. Also
regenerate whenever the pipeline string in
`provisioning/files/etc/systemd/system/uxplay.service` changes in a way
that needs a different plugin (update
`tools/gstreamer-plugin-allowlist.txt` first).
